# Pass without Trace (`spells:pass-without-trace`)
**Level 2 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe) | **Duration:** up to 1 hour | **Classes:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md)

You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
